bind_address.description: IP address to bind to. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces (not recommended for production without firewalling).

basedir.description: Base directory where the MariaDB binaries are installed.

datadir.description: Data directory where database files are stored.

tmpdir.description: Directory for temporary files (e.g., sorting, temp tables). Ensure it has sufficient space and proper permissions.

lc_messages_dir.description: Directory containing error message files for localization.

character_set_server.description: Default server character set. Use utf8mb4 for full Unicode support (including emoji).

collation_server.description: Default server collation. Match your language and sorting needs.

innodb_buffer_pool_size.description: Size of InnoDB buffer pool (memory for caching data and indexes). Recommended: ~70-80% of total RAM on dedicated DB server.

innodb_log_file_size.description: Size of each InnoDB log file in the log group. Larger sizes improve performance but increase crash recovery time.

innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit.description: Controls durability/speed tradeoff: 1 = safest (ACID), 2 = faster (OS flush), 0 = fastest (less safe). Use 1 for production.

innodb_file_per_table.description: Store each InnoDB table in its own .ibd file. Recommended for manageability and disk reclamation.

query_cache_size.description: Query cache size in bytes. 0 disables it (recommended for MariaDB ≥10.1 and modern workloads).

query_cache_type.description: Whether query cache is ON (true) or OFF (false). Ignored if query_cache_size = 0.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections. Increase if you see 'Too many connections' errors.

max_allowed_packet.description: Maximum size of a single packet or row. Increase for large INSERTs or BLOBs.

thread_cache_size.description: Number of threads to keep in cache for reuse. Tune to reduce thread creation overhead.

general_log.description: Enable general query logging (logs all statements). Use only for debugging — impacts performance and disk I/O.

general_log_file.description: Path to the general log file. Ensure directory exists and is writable by mysql user.

slow_query_log.description: Enable slow query logging (queries exceeding long_query_time). Critical for performance tuning.

slow_query_log_file.description: Path to the slow query log file.

long_query_time.description: Threshold in seconds for a query to be logged as 'slow'. Lower for stricter logging.

server_id.description: Unique server ID for replication. Must be > 0 to enable binary logging. Set to 0 to disable replication features.

log_bin.description: Base name/path for binary log files. Required for replication and point-in-time recovery.

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS for encrypted connections. Requires valid certificate/key files.

ssl_key_path.description: Path to SSL private key file.

key_buffer_size.description: Memory buffer for MyISAM index blocks. Relevant only if you use MyISAM tables.

read_buffer_size.description: Buffer size for sequential table scans.

read_rnd_buffer_size.description: Buffer size for random reads after sorting (e.g., ORDER BY with LIMIT).

sort_buffer_size.description: Memory per connection used for ORDER BY and GROUP BY operations.

join_buffer_size.description: Buffer size for full join operations (without indexes).

thread_stack.description: Stack size for each thread. Increase for deep recursion or large stored procedures.

timeout_connect.description: Seconds to wait for connection handshake before aborting.

timeout_interactive.description: Seconds of inactivity before closing an interactive connection.

timeout_slave.description: Seconds of inactivity before closing a replication slave connection.

wait_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before closing a non-interactive connection.

interactive_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before closing an interactive connection (same as timeout_interactive).

replicas.description: List of configured replicas (slaves). Each entry defines connection parameters for replication setup.

report_host.description: Hostname or IP used by the slave to report itself to the master (for SHOW SLAVE HOSTS).

report_user.description: Replication user account used to connect to this replica (for master-to-master setups).

log_file.description: Binary log file to start reading from (used only if auto_position=false).

log_pos.description: Position in binary log to start reading from (used only if auto_position=false).

default_storage_engine.description: Default storage engine for new tables. InnoDB is strongly recommended for production.

local_infile_enabled.description: Enable LOCAL INFILE (allows client to upload files). Set to false for security unless needed.

max_heap_table_size.description: Maximum size of in-memory temporary tables (MEMORY engine).

tmp_table_size.description: Maximum size of in-memory temporary tables (before spilling to disk).

open_files_limit.description: Maximum number of files the server can open. Increase for large databases with many tables.

table_open_cache.description: Number of open table descriptors to cache. Tune with open_files_limit.
